head: Wins Garden: daily wins journal app grows a flower for each day
dek: Wins Garden is a journal app for writing down what you got done each day, big or small, and each day you log becomes a flower in a garden. It costs $1.99 and was #85 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 24 November.
details: You can star the bigger wins and look back by day, month or year. An optional daily reminder nudges you to write. The app works offline, has no account and no ads, and you can back up your entries to a file. It's made by April Gao, came out on 21 November and needs iOS 16.4 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 16.4 or later), App Store, $1.99
means: If you end days feeling you did nothing, this gives you a quick place to list what you did, without signing up for anything.
todo: Look for Wins Garden on the App Store. Since there's no account, use the backup-to-file option now and then so your entries aren't lost if you change phones.
thumb_words: A FLOWER FOR EVERY DAILY WIN
